description: Power BI implementation for Sales team. Goal is to provide real-time dashboarding for regional sales performance, including KPI tracking, trend analysis, and executive summary views.
Marketing Analytics Data Warehouse upgrade. Delivering customer segment insights via Power BI with Azure SQL backend. Critical timeline pressure due to Q3 marketing campaign launch.
Finance reporting automation with Power BI and Azure Synapse Analytics. Consolidating 12 legacy Excel reports into a unified Power BI workspace with row-level security.
HR Analytics dashboard for employee engagement, attrition prediction, and workforce planning. Uses Dataverse as the data source with Power BI embedded reports.
Supply chain and logistics dashboard using Power BI with Azure Data Factory for ETL pipelines. Tracking inventory levels, delivery SLAs, and vendor performance across 3 regions.
